content:
Apple is rolling out a new round of RC (Release Candidate) versions of its software updates, including iPadOS 26.6, watchOS 26.6, and more. Here's what's new.

The RC versions signal that Apple's 26.6 updates are coming soon

Major new Apple software versions like iOS 27, iPadOS 27, and macOS Golden Gate are expected to launch in the fall.

But first, the current "OS 26" cycle will see another round of updates.

iOS 26.6, iPadOS 26.6, macOS 26.6 and more are all coming soon, and today the RC versions of those updates have been seeded.

Apple has seeded RC versions of its entire lineup of upcoming 26.6 updates, including iPadOS 26.6, watchOS 26.6, tvOS 26.6, and more.

The RC versions appear at the end of the testing period, meant to perfectly match the final software build that is released to the public shortly after.

However, it's not uncommon for Apple to discover additional last-minute bugs, leading to revised RC versions that include fixes.

In any case, with Apple now having the RC versions of 26.6 updates ready, those new versions should be released in roughly a week or so.

Throughout this current testing cycle, these updates appear to be primarily focused on under-the-hood improvements rather than new features. But if anything changes, we'll keep you posted.

Have you spotted anything new in the Apple 26.6 software updates or the RC versions? Let us know in the comments.

Featured iPad, Apple Watch, and Apple TV accessories

  • AirPods Pro 3 (now just $199, down from $249)
  • Apple Watch Portable USB-C Charger
  • 100W USB-C Fast Charging Power Adapter
  • Non-slip silicone case for Siri Remote, compatible with AirTag
  • HomeKit Smart Plug four-pack
